name: Void Boils OLD
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #3-17: Dreams of a Dustbound Isle
description: Tumor-like growths erupt from the isle as it responds to psychic attack, spewing black lightning and fire in every direction.
disable: DC 26 Occultism (trained) to reshape the substance of the dream, or DC 30 Performance (trained) or DC 28 Religion (trained) to invoke Desna's blessing through hymns or prayers. Each check to disable the hazard is a two-action activity; two total successes are required to disable the hazard.
routine: (1 action) On the hazard's initiative, a boil erupts from the ground and bursts. This blast strikes as many enemies as possible in a 15ft Burst anywhere on the isle, dealing 4d8 Force Damage damage (Basic DC 24 Reflex Saving Throw or Basic DC 24 Will Saving Throw, target's choice) to enemies in the area. Aslynn avoids targeting the nightmares with the blast.

generalAbilities.description:
Trigger Sarnia's psychic intrusion begins
